items.statement: Evidence covers browser/local-runner profiles rather than a broader native/production platform matrix.

items.statement: Optional AI/provider capability may be disabled or unavailable.

items.statement: Broad offline canonical mutation is unsupported.
items.mitigation: Require current online authority for governed mutation; recovery/reconnect evidence passed.

items.statement: Advanced map/vehicle behavior beyond the bounded tactical-position/basic-vehicle journeys is outside the established candidate evidence.
items.mitigation: Limit tester claims and charters to the proven journeys; record broader behavior as future work unless separately evidenced.

items.statement: Working/noncanonical Design Standards remain separately governed and unpromoted.
items.mitigation: Do not infer promotion or canonical status from Internal Alpha candidate validation.
